# PPC Guru

> PPC Guru is a Toronto-based digital marketing agency and Google Partner serving local service businesses across the Greater Toronto Area, Canada, and the United States.

PPC Guru provides Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, web design, conversion optimization, creative production, CRM, and AI automation services. The agency focuses on qualified leads, booked jobs, and revenue rather than vanity metrics.

Founded in 2021, PPC Guru is led by Jaydeep Patel, Founder and CEO, and Dhaval Patel, Co-founder and Head of Delivery. Services are provided month-to-month without long-term contracts. Advertising spend is separate from management fees, and clients retain ownership of their advertising accounts, data, billing, and associated assets.

Reported performance figures are blended, client-reported results and are representative rather than guaranteed. PPC Guru reports more than $100 million in managed advertising spend, more than 1 million qualified leads generated, a 6.3x average return on advertising spend, and more than 200 businesses served.

## Services

- [Google Ads Management](https://ppcguru.ca/services/google-ads): Google Ads strategy, campaign management, optimization, tracking, and lead generation.
- [ChatGPT Ads Management](https://ppcguru.ca/services/chatgpt-ads): Paid ChatGPT campaign planning, creative, landing pages and conversion measurement for eligible advertisers. Paid ads do not buy organic recommendations.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://ppcguru.ca/services/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram advertising for customer acquisition, lead generation, and remarketing.
- [SEO and Local Search](https://ppcguru.ca/services/seo): Search engine optimization, local SEO, content strategy, and organic visibility services.
- [Microsoft Advertising](https://ppcguru.ca/services/microsoft-ads): Microsoft Ads and Bing Ads campaign strategy, management, and optimization.
- [LinkedIn Ads](https://ppcguru.ca/services/linkedin-ads): LinkedIn advertising for B2B demand generation, professional audiences, and qualified leads.
- [TikTok Ads](https://ppcguru.ca/services/tiktok-ads): TikTok advertising strategy, creative testing, audience targeting, and campaign optimization.
- [Pinterest Ads](https://ppcguru.ca/services/pinterest-ads): Pinterest advertising for visual discovery, consideration, traffic, and conversions.
- [YouTube Ads](https://ppcguru.ca/services/youtube-ads): YouTube video advertising for awareness, demand generation, remarketing, and conversions.
- [Web Design and Landing Pages](https://ppcguru.ca/services/web-design): Conversion-focused website and landing-page design for service businesses.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization and Landing Pages](https://ppcguru.ca/services/cro-landing-pages): Landing-page strategy, testing, and conversion optimization for paid and organic traffic.
- [Creative Production](https://ppcguru.ca/services/creative): Advertising creative, copy, graphics, and video assets developed for campaign performance.
- [AI Automation](https://ppcguru.ca/services/ai-automation): AI-assisted lead handling, workflow automation, customer communication, and operational efficiency.
- [CRM and Marketing Operations](https://ppcguru.ca/services/crm): CRM implementation, lead tracking, pipeline management, reporting, and marketing operations.

## Free Tools

- [Google Ads ROI Calculator](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/google-ads-calculator): Estimate Google Ads leads, acquisition costs, revenue, and return on investment.
- [Meta Ads Calculator](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/meta-ads-calculator): Estimate Facebook and Instagram campaign performance, costs, and return.
- [ROAS Calculator](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/roas-calculator): Calculate return on advertising spend from campaign cost and attributed revenue.
- [Lead Quality Calculator](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/lead-quality-calculator): Evaluate lead quality, close rates, customer value, and campaign economics.
- [UTM Builder](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/utm-builder): Generate consistent campaign-tracking URLs using UTM parameters.
- [Instant AI Audit](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/instant-audit): Generate an automated review of website and digital marketing opportunities.
- [Ad Copy Generator](https://ppcguru.ca/tools/ad-copy-generator): Generate advertising copy concepts for paid-search and social campaigns.
